summary: Massachusetts has official PD43+ county-certified presidential rows, city/town/ward/precinct President-versus-U.S. Senate review rows, official PD43+ county historical presidential baselines for 2012/2016/2020, county geometry, EAC jurisdiction turnout fallback, statewide official turnout-statistics cross-checks, Verified Voting county equipment context, and official/request-path administration context. No production promotion is implied by this inventory.

presidentialCountyResults.authority: Massachusetts Secretary of the Commonwealth, PD43+
presidentialCountyResults.caveat: County rows come from official county-filtered PD43+ County Totals pages because the bulk precinct CSV does not carry county in the row schema.

localReviewRows.authority: Massachusetts Secretary of the Commonwealth, PD43+
localReviewRows.caveat: PD43+ review grouping is municipality-centric, not county-centric. President-versus-Senate rows are advisory screening context and cannot distinguish ordinary split-ticket voting from source, machine, or custody issues without additional evidence.

turnout.caveat: The Massachusetts turnout statistics page confirms statewide 2024 registered voters and total votes cast, but this pass did not identify an official city/town/ward/precinct turnout export to replace the active EAC jurisdiction fallback rows.
turnout.registrationStatisticsCaveat: Submitted Massachusetts registration statistics page publishes state election enrollment statistics, including 2024 and historical PDF/accessibility links. It is a statewide/local denominator source lead and cross-check path, not an active replacement for EAC jurisdiction turnout rows without compatible local ballots-cast rows.

historicalBaselines.authority: Massachusetts Secretary of the Commonwealth, PD43+
historicalBaselines.caveat: Rows are county-level contextual baseline rows. The 2020 PD43+ county rows sum one vote higher in non-D/R candidate votes than the statewide summary line; the collector preserves the official displayed county rows and validates that caveat.

geometry.caveat: County geometry supports county result maps. No official statewide precinct, ward, or municipal reporting-unit geometry/crosswalk is loaded for subcounty review overlays.

equipmentContext.caveat: Equipment rows are county-level context only and are not vote, turnout, audit, or proof of precinct-uniform equipment use.

audit.caveat: Official statewide post-election audit context is identified, but detailed municipal, precinct, batch, contest, discrepancy, and workpaper rows are not normalized.

cvr.requestPath: Massachusetts Secretary of the Commonwealth Elections Division, city/town clerks, or local election commissions depending on record custody.
cvr.caveat: No CVR dataset or county/municipal CVR availability table is loaded.

ballotImages.requestPath: Massachusetts Secretary of the Commonwealth Elections Division, city/town clerks, local election commissions, or vendor-hosted election-system exports depending on retention and custody.

logsLogicAccuracyCustody.requestPath: Secretary, city/town clerks, local election commissions, or voting-system vendors depending on record custody.
logsLogicAccuracyCustody.caveat: Tabulator/EMS logs, logic-and-accuracy records, and chain-of-custody records are request-path items only.

incidentsCorrectionsRecountsLitigation.requestPath: Massachusetts Secretary of the Commonwealth Elections Division and municipal custodians.
incidentsCorrectionsRecountsLitigation.caveat: No normalized 2024 incident, correction, recount, or litigation rows are loaded.

remainingGaps: official state-native local turnout or voter-participation denominator rows to replace EAC jurisdiction fallback
official precinct/ward/municipal geometry or reporting-unit crosswalk for subcounty review overlays
normalized detailed audit workpapers and discrepancy rows
CVR availability, ballot-image availability, tabulator/EMS logs, logic-and-accuracy, custody, incident, correction, recount, and litigation artifacts
advisoryUseCaveat: Massachusetts advisory indicators are source/data reconciliation signals only. They are not proof of fraud or misconduct and require source, demographic, contest, turnout, equipment, audit, and custody context before interpretation.
